about.title: About RM EV Services
about.subtitle: Building the charging infrastructure behind India's EV transition.
about.missionBody: RM EV Services Private Limited operates EV charging stations and supplies EV charging infrastructure and equipment, with franchise opportunities for partners who want to host a station on their property. We focus on reliable, well-maintained charging infrastructure rather than running the charging sessions ourselves — drivers use their existing EV charging apps to charge at our stations.
about.whatWeDoBody: We plan, supply, and install EV charging equipment, operate charging stations, and support franchise partners who host stations on their property — from site assessment through ongoing maintenance.
about.scopeBody: This website is an informational and lead-generation platform. It does not process charging payments, manage charging sessions, or control chargers remotely — those functions are handled by third-party EV charging apps. Use this site to find our stations, learn about our equipment and services, and get in touch about franchise opportunities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data RM EV Services Private Limited ("RM EV Services", "we", "us") collects through this website, why we collect it, and how it is used.
privacy.collectBody: We collect the personal data you voluntarily submit through our forms: name, phone number, and (optionally) email address on the Franchise Enquiry form, along with city, state, preferred location, property details, and your message; and name, and optionally email, phone, and a rating/message, on the Feedback form. We also process anonymous bot-protection signals (Cloudflare Turnstile) when you submit either form.
privacy.useBody: We use franchise enquiry details to evaluate and follow up on franchise opportunities, and feedback details to improve our stations and, where you allow it, to display your feedback as a testimonial on our home page. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.retentionBody: We retain franchise enquiries and feedback for as long as reasonably necessary to act on them and for our internal records, after which they may be deleted or anonymized.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us using the details on our Contact page, consistent with applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy-related questions, please reach out via our Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your use of the RM EV Services website. By using this site, you agree to these terms.
terms.purposeBody: This website provides information about RM EV Services' charging stations, equipment, and services, and allows visitors to submit franchise enquiries and feedback. It does not process payments, manage charging sessions, or control charging equipment. Actual EV charging is performed through third-party charging apps, subject to their own terms.
terms.accuracyBody: We aim to keep station status, specifications, and offers up to date, but details may change without notice. Please confirm critical details (such as station availability) directly with us if needed.
terms.conductBody: You agree not to misuse this website, including by submitting false information through our forms, attempting to bypass our bot-protection measures, or interfering with the site's normal operation.
terms.liabilityBody: This website is provided on an "as is" basis. RM EV Services is not liable for any loss arising from reliance on information published here, to the extent permitted by law.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
